create_vlm_engine_input: create a VlmEngineInput with a PIL image, text prompt, and generation parameters for VLM inference
run_vlm_engine_predict: run a VlmEngine to predict text output from an image and prompt via predict or __call__
build_vlm_engine_options: build engine options by subclassing BaseVlmEngineOptions with a Literal engine_type for automatic registration
test_vlm_engine_type: test if a VlmEngineType is an API or inline variant using is_api_variant and is_inline_variant
summarize_vlm_engine_output: summarize a VlmEngineOutput containing generated text, stop reason, and engine metadata
